KANBAN_TYPE_PROCESSES.DESCRIPTION: Manage your kanban type processes to organize conversations in different workflows. Create custom processes or use system defaults.
KANBAN_TYPE_PROCESSES.SIDEBAR_TXT:
Kanban Type Processes

Kanban type processes allow you to organize conversations into different workflows. Each type process can have multiple stages (kanban processes) that represent the progression of a conversation through your support workflow.

You can create custom type processes for different teams or use cases, such as 'Support Tickets', 'Sales Pipeline', or 'Bug Reports'. Each type process automatically gets default stages like 'To Do', 'In Progress', and 'Done'.

To add a new kanban type process, click on the 'Add new type process' button.
